Cucumber-edamame rice bowls

Original EZEATS recipe · editorially reviewed draft · owner review required · not kitchen-tested.

Warm rice and edamame contrast with crisp cucumber and rice vinegar.

Japanese-inspired · lunch, bowl · easy

Servings: 2

Prep: 5 min

Cook: 10 min

Total: 15 min (estimate)

Estimated cost: USD 5 per serving. Not a price quote or a CAD conversion.

Diet and allergy suitability: unverified. Ingredient-list screening only, for the exact products specified. Brands, substitutions and cross-contact can change suitability. Editorial review is not kitchen testing or a medical or allergy-safety guarantee.

Known allergens: Sesame, Soy. This list may be incomplete; check package labels and cross-contact.

Before you cook

  • Before starting, wash hands with soap and water for 20 seconds. Rinse fresh produce under running water and use clean utensils.
  • Check every packaged ingredient label for dietary requirements and allergens, including cross-contact notices. Choose products with no additional allergenic ingredients beyond the warnings listed here; otherwise these ingredient-based recommendations no longer apply. Listed tags apply only to the specified ingredients; they are not allergy-safe guarantees.
  • Refrigerate perishable ingredients until needed. Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within 2 hours (within 1 hour above 90°F/32°C); reheat leftovers to 74°C/165°F.

Ingredients

  • 1 1/2 cups frozen shelled edamame (Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 2 cups ready-cooked rice (Use a fresh sealed plain rice pouch or rice promptly chilled and refrigerated. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1/2 medium cucumber (diced)
  • 1 tablespoon unseasoned rice vinegar
  • 2 teaspoons gluten-free tamari (Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1 teaspoon sesame seeds (Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 3 cups water

Cooking instructions

  1. Bring the water to a boil and cook the frozen shelled edamame for its package time, usually 4–5 minutes; drain.
  2. Heat the ready-cooked rice according to its package until it reaches 74°C/165°F throughout.
  3. Toss the cucumber with the unseasoned rice vinegar and gluten-free tamari.
  4. Divide the rice and edamame between bowls, add the dressed cucumber and finish with sesame seeds.
